sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Review or add buy, sell, load, enabled PV and SOC sources. Append a today/tomorrow continuation; PV groups represent independent arrays. Sell only PV requires pv_energy_today (generation since local midnight) and grid_export_energy_today (export since local midnight) in kWh or Wh, resetting each local day. throughput_today constrains battery cycles; other measurements are diagnostic.

data.minimum_export_episode_benefit: Minimum benefit per additional battery-export period

planning.description: Edit fixed values or use the numeric helper editor. {detail}

data_description.minimum_mode_minutes: Default 60 min; 0 disables mode duration and mode power restrictions, but an enabled export-benefit hurdle still requires material discharge and export. Holds actual PV/grid charge, export, self-consumption, HOLD and CURTAIL modes. A source or sink change starts a new period. Exception: an observed SoC bound during an active commitment. A grid-charge price ceiling can also require HOLD without resetting the existing deadline.
data_description.limit_export_to_pv: Enabled by default. Solar and battery export cannot exceed PV generation on the same local calendar day. Combines observed totals since midnight with the remaining forecast; no credit carries between days. Select pv_energy_today and grid_export_energy_today daily counters in Sources. Off removes this budget; other limits remain active.
data_description.minimum_mode_power_kw: Default 0.1 kW (100 W); range 0.001–1000 kW. Minimum active power, not constant power. With duration 0 and the benefit hurdle enabled, applies only to simultaneous battery discharge and grid export. CURTAIL excludes battery charge and discharge only while the duration policy is enabled.
data_description.minimum_export_episode_benefit: Default 1 unit of installation currency (for example 1 PLN); range 0–1000, 0 disables. Each additional period must improve full-horizon physical cost versus fewer periods by at least this amount. Includes prices, losses, wear and optional terminal value; not a realized cycle-profit guarantee. An ongoing published period is exempt. With mode duration 0, the minimum power still applies to simultaneous discharge and export. Real low-power export may bridge a price valley without recharging.
data_description.minimum_grid_charge_episode_benefit: Default 0 (disabled); range 0-1000, 0 disables. Each additional grid-fed battery-charge period must improve full-horizon physical cost versus fewer periods by at least this amount. Includes prices, losses, wear and optional terminal value. An ongoing published period is exempt. Mirrors the export-episode benefit, but for grid-to-battery charging instead of battery export.
data_description.import_penalty_per_kwh: Default 0 (disabled); range 0-1000 per kWh. A planning-only shadow price added to every kWh imported from the grid, in every strategy. It makes the planner cover demand from the battery rather than hold it for a marginally better later price, and absorbs forecast error inside an interval. Reported costs stay in real currency and never include it. Self-sufficiency uses the larger of this and its own import price.
data_description.peak_reserve_margin_kwh: Default 0 (off); range 0-100 kWh. Extra energy kept above the forecast need when an expensive-price period starts (buy price above the grid-charge ceiling, or above the cheapest price when there is no ceiling). A planning-only soft floor that absorbs load above the forecast; reported costs never include it.
data_description.maximum_grid_charge_price: Final purchase price after tariff adjustments, in installation currency/kWh. Prices equal to the ceiling are allowed. Range −1000–1000; zero permits only zero or negative prices. Applies only when the toggle is enabled. Household supply and surplus-PV charging remain available.
data_description.limit_grid_charge_price: Disabled by default. Blocks battery charging from the grid above the ceiling, including with mode duration zero. New charging runs need eligible prices for their full minimum duration. If a carried charging commitment conflicts with the ceiling during its remaining duration, advice pauses immediately in HOLD until the original deadline, without resetting its clock.
data_description.grid_friendly_import_cap_kw: Soft cap on grid import power under the grid_friendly strategy, in kW. 0 uses the site's grid import limit instead of a separate cap.
data_description.grid_friendly_export_cap_kw: Soft cap on grid export power under the grid_friendly strategy, in kW. 0 uses the site's grid export limit instead of a separate cap.

data_description.short_coverage: Used when a full reference-interval probe fails or its compute budget expires. A failed clipped tail stays unknown while successful full intervals keep percentile guidance.
data_description.flexible_load_max_power_kw: Maximum average power available to each flexible-load profile.
data_description.flexible_price_degradation_percent: Maximum unfavorable marginal block-price change from the 3 kWh anchor.
